styles.name: Kontextinspektor
styles.idea: Breite Hauptfläche mit einem schmalen, auf die Auswahl reagierenden rechten Inspektor.
styles.layout: A wide working surface and a slim right selection inspector; keep the conventional left object tree.

styles.name: Prioritätsbahnen
styles.idea: Die wichtigste Aufgabe erhält ein breites Arbeitsband; Diagnose und Details liegen darunter.
styles.layout: A dominant upper work lane, a compact subordinate evidence lane below, one stable context rail.

styles.name: Geführter Kontext
styles.idea: Ein kompakter Ablaufstreifen führt durch Aufgaben, während Daten und Kontext sichtbar bleiben.
styles.layout: A thin meaningful workflow strip above the main task, compact context sidebar and inline detail panels.

styles.name: Master und Detail
styles.idea: Objektliste links, präzise Detailfläche rechts und eine gemeinsame Aktionsleiste.
styles.layout: A compact searchable master list, dominant detail surface, shared contextual action toolbar.

styles.name: Verknüpfte Werkbank
styles.idea: Auswahl, Arbeitsfläche und Belege bleiben durch klare Zuordnung verbunden.
styles.layout: Three aligned panes for objects, primary work and evidence, clearly keyed selections and subtle relationship connectors.

styles.name: Signal und Beleg
styles.idea: Eine wichtige Kennzahl steht über dem zugehörigen Verlauf und den überprüfbaren Details.
styles.layout: An evidence-led layout: compact summary, large primary analysis surface, lower trace or detail drawer.

styles.name: Gepaarte Flächen
styles.idea: Zwei synchronisierte Arbeitsbereiche erleichtern Vergleiche ohne Kontextwechsel.
styles.layout: Two aligned primary subpanes inside the existing app shell, a shared filter/context bar and compact footer review.

styles.name: Aufgabenkontinuität
styles.idea: Entwurf, Fortschritt und Ergebnis bilden einen nachvollziehbaren Arbeitsfluss.
styles.layout: A focused task canvas, persistent compact draft/progress strip, adjacent preview or summary with clear stage order.

styles.name: Fokussierte Arbeitsfläche
styles.idea: Das aktive Objekt bekommt maximalen Platz; Hilfen bleiben in einem schmalen Seitenbereich.
styles.layout: Expand the dominant work canvas while retaining the 56px navigation rail and compact contextual object outline; quiet side detail drawer.

styles.name: Kontextband
styles.idea: Verbindung und aktive Filter stehen in einem ruhigen Kontextband über den Daten.
styles.layout: Use a precise horizontal context ribbon above the working surface with a slim object list and a useful bottom result strip.

styles.name: Entscheidung mit Vorschau
styles.idea: Vor einer Änderung sind Wirkung, betroffene Objekte und Rückweg sichtbar.
styles.layout: A large preview, compact decision panel on the right, clear change evidence below and a single primary action.

styles.name: Explorationsspalten
styles.idea: Zusammengehörige Informationen lassen sich in stabilen, beschrifteten Spalten untersuchen.
styles.layout: Stable semantic columns for navigation, central exploration and selected-object details; one coherent task hierarchy.

styles.name: Gestufte Details
styles.idea: Grundlegende Werkzeuge bleiben sichtbar; zusätzliche Details öffnen sich im gleichen Kontext.
styles.layout: Visible essential controls, a dominant work pane, expanded in-context advanced section with clear labels and compact supporting metadata.

styles.name: Objektlinse
styles.idea: Das ausgewählte Objekt verbindet Daten, Struktur und relevante Folgeaktionen.
styles.layout: A selected-object lens integrated at the edge of the primary surface, subtle keyed row selection and nearby contextual actions.

styles.name: Prüfbereich
styles.idea: Eine untere Prüfzone sammelt Änderungen, Belege und den nächsten kontrollierten Schritt.
styles.layout: A broad primary work area, a shallow bottom review shelf, stable object sidebar and precisely grouped toolbar.

styles.name: Workflow-Brücke
styles.idea: Vorbereitung und Ergebnis stehen nebeneinander mit klarer Zuordnung.
styles.layout: A left preparation pane and a larger right live preview/result pane, connected by numbered labeled workflow steps in a slim header.

styles.name: Strukturierte Übersicht
styles.idea: Eine ruhige Übersicht zeigt die wichtigen Einstiegspunkte und Details der Auswahl.
styles.layout: An asymmetric but disciplined overview: one dominant section, two small useful context regions and a right detail column.

styles.name: Kontextanker
styles.idea: Filter, letzte Auswahl und offene Aufgaben bleiben während der Arbeit sichtbar.
styles.layout: A persistent compact context anchor with current selection and draft state, main workspace, related evidence drawer with no floating clutter.

styles.name: Kompakter Arbeitsplatz
styles.idea: Präzise verdichtete Bereiche schaffen mehr Platz für Daten bei klarer Hierarchie.
styles.layout: A dense professional arrangement with legible 14px-equivalent data, compact non-overlapping toolbars, clear separators and enlarged main target controls.

styles.name: Ruhiger Arbeitsfluss
styles.idea: Wenige klar gegliederte Bereiche führen vom Einstieg bis zum sichtbaren Ergebnis.
styles.layout: A calm linear task hierarchy inside the existing desktop shell: compact preparation area, dominant working stage, concise outcome and next action.

views.name: SQL-Arbeitsplatz
views.brief: A SQL editor with a credible 7-line SELECT joining public.users and orders, a results grid of 8 rows, query tabs, Ausführen, Explain, 248 Zeilen and 12 ms. Show active filters and selected-row details.

views.name: Tabellen-Explorer
views.brief: A wide public.users grid with 10 records, id, name, email, status, created_at; sort indicators, filter chips, selected cell, type-aware row detail and 2 pending edits with Prüfen.

views.name: ER-Diagramm
views.brief: An ER diagram containing 6 clean table cards for users, orders, order_items, products, payments and addresses, PK/FK badges, proper labeled relationship connectors, minimap, selected-table column inspector.

views.name: Query Builder
views.brief: A visual SQL builder with selected users and orders, a real join condition, grouped fields and filters, readable generated SQL preview and a compact sample result grid. One Ausführen primary action.

views.name: Ausführungsplan
views.brief: A real-looking execution plan: 84 ms total, plan tree with Hash Join and Index Scan nodes, honest percentage bars, selected-node evidence and source SQL, one Optimieren action with contextual help.

views.name: Live-Monitor
views.brief: A live database monitor: sessions, throughput, CPU and locks; a large readable activity chart, an active query table and selected-session details. Show timestamps, running state and Stoppen, no fabricated improvement claims.

views.name: Datenbank-Health
views.brief: A database health assessment with 4 grouped checks, factual statuses, one index warning with affected table and supporting evidence, a prioritized issue list, resolved-check summary.

views.name: Datenbankübersicht
views.brief: A database overview with size 122 MB, 6 tables, active connection and schema; restrained KPI blocks, useful size trend and the main object list with selection details and direct SQL action.

views.name: Abfrageverlauf
views.brief: Query history with grouped dates, a searchable list, SQL snippet, execution time, source connection, saved draft indicator and a large selected-query result preview. Clearly show Erneut ausführen.

views.name: Automatisierung
views.brief: A scheduled query workflow with labeled connected steps Abfrage, Export, Ziel; schedule and next run, factual recent-run log, execution status and primary Speichern. No invented urgent countdowns.

views.name: SQL-Notebook
views.brief: A SQL notebook combining a short German analysis note, two numbered SQL cells, a useful result grid and a small sales chart. A clear outline, actual unfinished cell badge, run-cell controls and final outcome.

views.name: AI-Arbeitsbereich
views.brief: A database AI workspace showing a German request Umsatz nach Monat, a readable proposed SQL query with named data sources, result preview and explicit Prüfen before execution. Clear read-only scope and grounded evidence, no opaque confidence score.

views.name: Datenvergleich
views.brief: Two synchronized result tables comparing staging and production with labeled source headers, aligned highlighted differences, totals of changed rows, selected-change detail and review before applying anything.

views.name: Schema-Vergleich
views.brief: Schema comparison staging vs production: a meaningful object diff tree, exact before and after column definitions, readable migration SQL preview, risk annotation with text and icon and primary Änderungen prüfen.

views.name: Transaktionsprüfung
views.brief: A transaction review showing 3 pending row edits, exact previous and proposed values, affected-row count and readable SQL, separate Verwerfen and primary Prüfen/Bestätigen controls with clear target connection.

views.name: Verbindungen
views.brief: Connection manager with 6 named connections grouped development, staging, production; database family labels, a selected PostgreSQL connection form, masked password, URL import, Testen and specific validation feedback.

views.name: Datenimport
views.brief: A CSV import workflow at step 2 of 3 with truthful mapping progress, source preview, target columns and types, 1 clearly described invalid date, a useful sample table and primary Vorschau prüfen.

views.name: Objektspeicher
views.brief: An object-storage workspace with bucket outline, prefix breadcrumbs, file table showing CSV and Parquet names, size and last modified, selected object metadata and explicit upload progress with cancel.

views.name: Einstellungen
views.brief: Appearance and workflow settings with familiar vertical category navigation, labeled grouped setting rows, light/dark preview, density options, helpful descriptions, precise default/reset action and one Speichern action.

views.name: MCP und Zugriff
views.brief: An MCP access workspace with server state, named tools and permissions, connection scope, a factual request log, selected-tool details, masked credential and a clear Verbindung testen action.

images.idea: Breite Hauptfläche mit einem schmalen, auf die Auswahl reagierenden rechten Inspektor.
images.prompt:
Use the supplied real current l8db screenshot strictly as CORPORATE DESIGN reference, not as a layout to copy. Preserve the small plain l8db wordmark, IBM Plex Sans-style sans serif UI text, monospace SQL/data, thin Lucide-style outline icons, cool neutral surfaces, very low-chroma muted slate/steel-blue accents, fine gray borders, small softly rounded rectangular controls, about 12px panel radii, restrained shadows and professional readable dense grids. Retain the recognizable compact 46px app header, centered Suchen command pill, 56px left feature rail and contextual object navigation. No new logo, neon, gradient decoration, glass, 3D, serif display font, whimsical furniture or arbitrary colorful brand palette. Semantic green/amber/red only in small labeled status/error areas. Make a fresh polished innovative but plausible l8db DESKTOP UI screen, direct flat screenshot filling the image, landscape 1600x1000 composition, no device frame, poster title, collage or explanatory annotations outside the app. Prefer clear German UI labels and realistic restrained technical content.

LIGHT theme: pale cool off-white/silver background and white inset surfaces, dark ink type, muted steel-blue selection and primary controls.

Distinct layout concept Kontextinspektor: A wide working surface and a slim right selection inspector; keep the conventional left object tree.

Required view SQL-Arbeitsplatz: A SQL editor with a credible 7-line SELECT joining public.users and orders, a results grid of 8 rows, query tabs, Ausführen, Explain, 248 Zeilen and 12 ms. Show active filters and selected-row details.

Laws of UX design requirements, adapted to the actual screen: Consistent, restrained visual polish; never sacrifice legibility. Group choices by task; show essentials and reveal advanced options. Use meaningful chunks for connection, object, task and result. Use neutral labels, contextual evidence and honest defaults. One dominant task with visible context and a clear next action. Show running, cancel and progress states when applicable; latency is an implementation requirement. Use generous separated targets for important controls close to the task. Preserve working context and avoid unnecessary interruption. Use truthful completed and remaining steps for multi-step tasks. Prioritize actions and divide difficult decisions into clear steps. Keep familiar desktop conventions, tabs, object tree and l8db navigation. Enclose related information in clear shared regions. Keep related labels, values and actions close. Use simple forms and an immediately readable hierarchy. Give equivalent functions consistent styling and states. Show actual relationships with clear labeled connectors or alignment. Follow connection, database, schema, object mental models. Chunk meaningfully; do not enforce a magical seven-item limit. Remove redundant decorative or functional elements. Enable immediate action with examples and contextual help. Put likely frequent actions first; verify priorities with usage research. Scope tasks and offer useful defaults without artificial pressure. Finish workflows with a clear outcome and useful next action. Accept practical input formats, validate explicitly and output precisely. Emphasize the selected item and relevant warning, quiet secondary tools. Place primary steps first and outcomes or next actions last. Move routine work to the system without hiding necessary complexity. One clear primary action; semantic color paired with text and icons. Keep filters, drafts and comparison values visible rather than recalled. Mark actual unfinished drafts and tasks with truthful status. Separate primary, secondary and destructive actions. Pair status colors with words/icons. Preserve comfortable text contrast, clear focus styling and space around click targets; do not cram controls to match the reference density. Show only states relevant to this view. This is a static design proposal; do not claim measured latency, keyboard operation or accessibility compliance.

Give the actual primary working content at least half of the screenshot; use only useful context panes. Crisp readable professional product mockup, coherent component system.

Use the supplied real current l8db screenshot strictly as CORPORATE DESIGN reference, not as a layout to copy. Preserve the small plain l8db wordmark, IBM Plex Sans-style sans serif UI text, monospace SQL/data, thin Lucide-style outline icons, cool neutral surfaces, very low-chroma muted slate/steel-blue accents, fine gray borders, small softly rounded rectangular controls, about 12px panel radii, restrained shadows and professional readable dense grids. Retain the recognizable compact 46px app header, centered Suchen command pill, 56px left feature rail and contextual object navigation. No new logo, neon, gradient decoration, glass, 3D, serif display font, whimsical furniture or arbitrary colorful brand palette. Semantic green/amber/red only in small labeled status/error areas. Make a fresh polished innovative but plausible l8db DESKTOP UI screen, direct flat screenshot filling the image, landscape 1600x1000 composition, no device frame, poster title, collage or explanatory annotations outside the app. Prefer clear German UI labels and realistic restrained technical content.

DARK theme: near-black cool blue-charcoal background, subtly lighter slate inset panels, off-white type and desaturated pale steel-blue accents. Avoid crushed black content or glowing borders.

Distinct layout concept Aufgabenkontinuität: A focused task canvas, persistent compact draft/progress strip, adjacent preview or summary with clear stage order.

Required view Verbindungen: Connection manager with 6 named connections grouped development, staging, production; database family labels, a selected PostgreSQL connection form, masked password, URL import, Testen and specific validation feedback.

Laws of UX design requirements, adapted to the actual screen: Consistent, restrained visual polish; never sacrifice legibility. Group choices by task; show essentials and reveal advanced options. Use meaningful chunks for connection, object, task and result. Use neutral labels, contextual evidence and honest defaults. One dominant task with visible context and a clear next action. Show running, cancel and progress states when applicable; latency is an implementation requirement. Use generous separated targets for important controls close to the task. Preserve working context and avoid unnecessary interruption. Use truthful completed and remaining steps for multi-step tasks. Prioritize actions and divide difficult decisions into clear steps. Keep familiar desktop conventions, tabs, object tree and l8db navigation. Enclose related information in clear shared regions. Keep related labels, values and actions close. Use simple forms and an immediately readable hierarchy. Give equivalent functions consistent styling and states. Show actual relationships with clear labeled connectors or alignment. Follow connection, database, schema, object mental models. Chunk meaningfully; do not enforce a magical seven-item limit. Remove redundant decorative or functional elements. Enable immediate action with examples and contextual help. Put likely frequent actions first; verify priorities with usage research. Scope tasks and offer useful defaults without artificial pressure. Finish workflows with a clear outcome and useful next action. Accept practical input formats, validate explicitly and output precisely. Emphasize the selected item and relevant warning, quiet secondary tools. Place primary steps first and outcomes or next actions last. Move routine work to the system without hiding necessary complexity. One clear primary action; semantic color paired with text and icons. Keep filters, drafts and comparison values visible rather than recalled. Mark actual unfinished drafts and tasks with truthful status. Separate primary, secondary and destructive actions. Pair status colors with words/icons. Preserve comfortable text contrast, clear focus styling and space around click targets; do not cram controls to match the reference density. Show only states relevant to this view. This is a static design proposal; do not claim measured latency, keyboard operation or accessibility compliance.

Give the actual primary working content at least half of the screenshot; use only useful context panes. Crisp readable professional product mockup, coherent component system.

HIGHEST PRIORITY CORPORATE COLOR LOCK: reference colors are deliberately almost neutral. Dark primary button fill must be desaturated pale steel #b5c5d5, with dark ink label; selection fill #243442, underline #9cafbf. Use these muted gray-blue colors for ALL primary buttons, active tabs, selection borders and workflow accents. Never use saturated cobalt, royal blue, electric blue or cyan buttons/underlines. Keep SQL keywords restrained muted blue too. The result must look like the SAME l8db brand as the real screenshot, with a different useful layout.
